entities.name: the tanker On Peace
entities.look: Large commercial oil tanker, weathered hull, superstructure at the stern.

entities.name: the GFS Pride
entities.look: Singapore-flagged container ship, stacked colorful containers on deck.

places.name: Strait of Hormuz
places.look: Narrow strip of blue water between arid coastlines and rocky islands under clear daylight.

moments.action: Hit by a projectile and caught fire.
moments.cue: the tanker On Peace was hit about nine nautical miles off Limah, on Oman's coast, and caught fire.

moments.action: Sank near the strait after being hit.
moments.cue: a Singapore-flagged container ship, the GFS Pride, sank near the strait.
